-- Let me verify the calculations manually:
-- 531 (Pallet of L) -> 521 (qty 12) -> 502 (qty 72): 12 * 72 = 864 ✓
-- 532 (Pallet of M) -> 522 (qty 20) -> 501 (qty 36): 20 * 36 = 720 ✓
-- 533 (Pallet Mix MS) -> 522 (qty 10) -> 501 (qty 36): 10 * 36 = 360 (< 500, excluded) ✓
-- 533 (Pallet Mix MS) -> 523 (qty 20) -> 502 (qty 30): 20 * 30 = 600 ✓
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> 523 (qty 20) -> 502 (qty 30): 20 * 30 = 600
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> 524 (qty 16) -> 511 (qty 8) -> 501 (qty 3): 16 * 8 * 3 = 384 (< 500, excluded) ✓
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> 524 (qty 16) -> 511 (qty 8) -> 502 (qty 2): 16 * 8 * 2 = 256
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> 524 (qty 16) -> 502: Does 524 directly contain 502? No! Only 511.
-- Wait, let me check the earlier output more carefully. The query showed 534 -> 502 with 600 and 256.
-- 600 = 20 * 30 (via 523), 256 = 16 * 8 * 2 (via 524 -> 511 -> 502)
-- Total for 534 -> 502 = 600 + 256 = 856 ✓

-- All looks correct. Let me also verify 534 -> 501: only path is 534 -> 524 -> 511 -> 501 = 16*8*3 = 384 (< 500)

-- The result is correct. Now let me format it properly with integer quantities.
SELECT top_name, leaf_name, CAST(total_qty AS INTEGER) AS total_qty
FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
        SELECT 
            r.packaging_id AS top_id,
            r.contains_id AS current_id,
            r.qty AS accumulated_qty
        FROM packaging_relations r
        WHERE r.packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            h.top_id,
            r.contains_id AS current_id,
            h.accumulated_qty * r.qty
        FROM hierarchy h
        JOIN packaging_relations r ON r.packaging_id = h.current_id
    )
    SELECT 
        p.name AS top_name,
        leaf.name AS leaf_name,
        SUM(h.accumulated_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging p ON p.id = h.top_id
    JOIN packaging leaf ON leaf.id = h.current_id
    WHERE h.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY h.top_id, p.name, leaf.name
    HAVING SUM(h.accumulated_qty) > 500
)
ORDER BY top_name, leaf_name
